title: Geomagnetic anomalies at UFO hotspots
place_text: Skinwalker Ranch; Mount Sangun Mori, Japan; Hessdalen

tellings.quote: like Skinwalker Ranch or Mount Sangun Mori uh in Japan uh next to the Fukushima Prefecture, their nuclear civilian grid, you always have these geomagnetic anomalies.

plain: Places famous for UFO reports, such as Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for strange happenings, and Mount Sangun Mori in Japan, next to Fukushima Prefecture and its civilian nuclear grid, always show geomagnetic anomalies, meaning unusual local quirks in the Earth's magnetic field. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with the treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, and the point would be that something about the ground itself may draw these sightings.
